name: GetWIKI plugin lets you embed a Wikipedia article anywhere in your blog. Installation is the simple drop-in-your-plugins-directory method that most WP plugins follow. Once installed, you can embed a WIKI article in your post with ease. The plugin currently looks for redirects, but does not handle other HTTP responses.
description: This plugin has been closed as of May 28, 2008 and is not available for download. Reason: Guideline Violation.
